concerns.text: T005 (contract/data-model update to four-ROI, six-edge, signed-primary) is scheduled AFTER T004, but T004 is a consumer of those contracts: it writes `connectivity_{subject_id}_{condition}.json` and computes six unique ROI-pair edges, which cannot validate against the current three-ROI `connectivity.schema.yaml` (nodes/matrix/strength_absolute-primary) until T005 lands. T005 itself states it must occur 'BEFORE any downstream statistics', yet T004 is downstream of the contract change. Reorder so T005 precedes T004 (T003's timeseries schema is already four-ROI, so T003 is unaffected), or explicitly state that T004's JSON validation is deferred to T005's updated schema.
